Package org.apache.juneau.secret.macos.keychain

package org.apache.juneau.secret.macos.keychain
An opt-in SecretStore backed by the macOS security keychain CLI.

This is deliberately a separate module rather than part of juneau-commons: it shells out to an external OS process, which the commons zero-runtime-deps / no-OS-integration philosophy keeps out of core. Add this module to the classpath (or wire KeychainSecretStore into a BeanStore) to back secret storage with the user's login keychain on macOS.

Since:
10.0.0
